data.name: Beffrey
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Bartholomaios', meaning 'son of Talmai'. This name became 'Beffrey' due to phonetic shifts over time. In the New Testament, Bartholomaios is one of the twelve apostles, also known as Nathanael or Nathaniel. He is known for his quick faith and is believed to have been crucified in India. Beffrey carries the spiritual significance of God's grace and faith.
